newsitem.title: USA: Comcast unit to make $900mln placement.
newsitem.headline: Comcast unit to make $900mln placement.

text.p: Comcast Corp said Thursday that its wholly owned subsidiary, Comcast Cellular Holdings Inc intends to offer approximately $900 million of senior notes in a private placement.
The company said the notes will be obligations of Comcast Cellular and will not be obligations of, nor guaranteed by, Comcast Corp.

Comcast said the interest rate and certain other terms of the notes have not yet been determined, and there is no assurance that acceptable terms will be reached or that the offering will be consummated.

Comcast Cellular anticipates using the net proceeds from the offering to redeem in full all outstanding series A and series B senior participating redeemable zero coupon notes due 2000 of Comcast Cellular, and to repay a portion of the outstanding borrowings under a credit facility of Comcast Cellular Communications Inc , a subsidiary of Comcast Cellular Holdings.
